formats.key: depositWithExpiry(address vault,address asset,uint256 amount,string memo,uint256 expiration)
effects: Reverts if block.timestamp is at or past `expiration`.
When `asset` is the zero address, the signer's whole msg.value in ETH goes through the router to `vault`; the `amount` parameter is ignored.
When `asset` is a token, msg.value must be 0, and the router pulls `amount` of `asset` from the signer with transferFrom, using the signer's existing allowance to the router.
For a token, the router keeps the tokens and credits the received balance difference to `vault`'s internal allowance; the vault controls them from then on.
The `memo` string tells the off-chain vault what to do with the deposit (swap destination, limit, affiliate). The contract only emits it in the Deposit event.
formats.shown: "Deposit to Harbor" with ETH Sent (@.value), Amount (if token) in the asset's token or ETH, the vault address, the raw memo string and the expiry date; the asset is hidden but resolves the amount's token.

findings.title: depositWithExpiry shows the `amount` parameter as ETH on native deposits, but the code ignores it and sends msg.value.
findings.evidence: Harbor_RouterV5.sol deposit(): `if(asset == address(0)){ safeAmount = msg.value; bool success = vault.send(safeAmount);` — `amount` is not read. Descriptor: field `amount` 'Amount (if token)' with `nativeCurrencyAddress: [0x000…000]`, so case 0 shows 'Amount (if token): 0.086371658133783935 ETH' next to 'ETH Sent'. In the cases the two values match, but nothing in the code makes them match, so the screen can show two different ETH amounts.
findings.fix: Remove `nativeCurrencyAddress` from the `amount` field, or change its label to "Token amount (ignored for ETH)", so that only 'ETH Sent' states the native amount.

findings.title: depositWithExpiry puts the real action (swap destination, minimum out, affiliate fee) in a raw memo string.
findings.evidence: Harbor_RouterV5.sol deposit(): `emit Deposit(vault, asset, safeAmount, memo);` — the contract does not act on memo. Case 2 memo '=:b:bc1qfgndd…/0xB681…:12485043/300:sk/t:5/50'. The intent says only 'Deposit to Harbor'. The blind readers in cases 1–3 could not tell what arrives or what the minimum is.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can decode the memo. Consider an intent such as "Deposit to Harbor vault (memo sets the action)".

findings.title: depositWithExpiry shows the vault as a bare address, so the signer cannot check that it is a real Harbor vault.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `vault` 'Vault' format addressName, types ['eoa'], no sources. All cases render '0x00dE4d8658ab249627286fCf9f920B3078aEa4fe'. The ETH or the token credit goes to this address (`vault.send` / `_vaultAllowance[vault][asset] += safeAmount`). The vault set rotates off-chain, so no constant can name it.

cases.notes: 0.086371658133783935 ETH out to the vault through the router. 'ETH Sent' shows it right. The ignored `amount` parameter has the same value.
0.062828923946576571 ETH out to the vault. Shown right.
